speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, can you tell me if the double vision and weakness fluctuate throughout the day or are they constant? Also, have you noticed any changes in your speech, swallowing, or facial muscles?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any difficulty swallowing, slurred speech, or weakness in your facial muscles, such as difficulty smiling or closing your eyes? Have you noticed that your symptoms are worse later in the day or after prolonged use of those muscles?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.
